search_text:
设函数 $f(x,y)$ 在区域 $D:y^2\leq-x,x^2\leq y$ 上连续，则二重积分 $\iint_Df(x,y)dxdy$ 可化累次积分为[\quad] $\int_{-1}^0dx\int_{-\sqrt x}^{x^2}f(x,y)dy$ $\int_0^1dy\int_{\sqrt y}^{y^2}f(x,y)dx$ $\int_0^1dy\int_{-\sqrt y}^{-y^2}f(x,y)dx$ $\int_{-1}^0dx\int_{-\sqrt x}^{x^2}f(x,y)dy$ 解答 由 $y^2=-x,x^2=y$ 解得交点为 $(0,0),(-1,1)$，所以
$$
\iint_Df(x,y)dxdy=\int_0^1dy\int_{-\sqrt{y}}^{-y^2}f(x,y)dx.
$$
